steps.name: Launch the exact V076 production candidate
steps.acceptance: A human starts the exact candidate from the player-facing entry with no debug fixture or compatibility fallback.

steps.name: Boot deterministic authority and record identity
Generate the shared half-edge spherical partition
Exercise debug-sphere rotate, zoom, hit-test, and highlight
steps.evidence: Scripted rotate/zoom/spherical-triangle hit/shared-boundary highlight with mapping parity
steps.claim_limit: Isolated scripted debug capability, not production human interaction.

steps.name: Exercise one deterministic Monster L1 geodesic route
steps.evidence: 47/47, 1,000 seeds x 2 replay with zero mismatch, warning-clean Bench PASS

steps.name: Complete human new-game setup and enter the production table
steps.acceptance: Human choices, AI seats, public setup facts, and private starting state reach the playable table once.

steps.name: Inspect the production globe and select a legal target
steps.required_surface: production map and typed target binding
steps.acceptance: Rotation, zoom, popup, and target selection use the production surface without changing authority.

steps.name: Acquire and submit one legal card through its real owner
steps.required_surface: production acquisition, hand, target, and resolution owners
steps.acceptance: One exact card instance moves through acquisition and submission with privacy and exact-once consumption intact.

steps.name: Resolve a production Monster directional move and visible consequence
steps.acceptance: A real player action reaches the unique Monster owner, moves over the bound map, and presents crossings/trample once.
steps.diagnostic_warning: The current Stage 3 Bench explicitly records human_golden_step_06_09=false and cannot satisfy this step.

steps.name: Resolve one military Direct Action
steps.required_surface: future private Direct Action channel and military owner
steps.acceptance: The exact card/action binding reaches one military owner without public-batch leakage or retargeting.

steps.name: Observe economy, route, and asset consequences
steps.acceptance: The authoritative consequence is visible exactly once without a duplicate asset ledger or presentation-owned mutation.

steps.name: Observe AI action and hidden-information integrity
steps.acceptance: AI takes a legal action while private hands, plans, and cash remain hidden from unauthorized viewers.

steps.name: Reach victory qualification and final audit
steps.acceptance: A full human run reaches the authoritative qualification and final-audit states without fixture injection.

steps.name: Present FinalSettlement exactly once
steps.acceptance: Winner facts, public log, and FinalSettlement agree and present exactly once.

steps.name: Record feedback and cleanly stop
steps.acceptance: Human feedback is captured, terminal state is quiescent, and all scoped processes and endpoints stop cleanly.
